title: Derived base change for a bounded relatively flat complex
statement: Let f:X\to S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let G^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent \mathcal O_X-modules flat over S. For every morphism g:T\to S, with base change g':X_T\to X and f_T:X_T\to T, the canonical map Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}G^\bullet) [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] \to Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{X_T}}(g')^*G^\bullet) is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_T).

proof.text: The single-complex base-change criterion [lem-pc-rf-base-change-single-complex-criterion] applies to the qcqs morphism f, the arbitrary E in D_QCoh, and the bounded-above quasi-coherent complex G, once its stated stalkwise base-change condition is verified.

Because every term of G is flat over S, the stalkwise flat-complex lemma [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tor-independent-flat-complex] verifies exactly that condition: at each x' and degree i the displayed stalkwise base-change map (Tag 0DJ8, condition (1)) is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0A1D (lemma-base-change-tensor), proof paragraph checking the condition on stalks

proof.text: Substituting this verified stalkwise condition into the criterion yields the canonical isomorphism Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L G^\bullet)\cong Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L(g')^*G^\bullet).
